properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 11:29AM CDT until August 9 at 12:00PM CDT by NWS Milwaukee/Sullivan WI
properties.description:
At 1129 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Hales Corners,
moving east at 35 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Milwaukee, West Allis, Wauwatosa, New Berlin, Brookfield, Greenfield,
Menomonee Falls, Oak Creek, Muskego, South Milwaukee, Cudahy,
Whitefish Bay, Greendale, Brown Deer, St. Francis, Hales Corners, Fox
Point, Elm Grove, Bayside, and West Milwaukee.

People attending The Greenfield Farmers Market , and The Riverwest
Farmers Market  should seek safe shelter immediately!
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with this storm, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued August 9 at 10:57AM CDT until August 9 at 12:30PM CDT by NWS Milwaukee/Sullivan WI
properties.description:
SMWMKX

The National Weather Service in Milwaukee/Sullivan has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Lake Michigan nearshore and open waters to mid lake from Sheboygan
WI to Winthrop Harbor IL...

* Until 1230 PM CDT.

* At 1056 AM CDT, strong thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 6 nm west of Port Washington to 33 nm northwest of
McHenry, moving east at 40 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Port Washington
Milwaukee
Racine
Kenosha.
properties.instruction: Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 11:28AM CDT until August 9 at 12:15PM CDT by NWS Milwaukee/Sullivan WI
properties.description:
SVRMKX

The National Weather Service in Milwaukee/Sullivan has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Eastern Walworth County in southeastern Wisconsin...
Racine County in southeastern Wisconsin...
Kenosha County in southeastern Wisconsin...

* Until 1215 PM CDT.

* At 1128 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Rochester,
or near Wind Lake, moving east at 40 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage
to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Kenosha, Racine, Mount Pleasant, Pleasant Prairie, Antioch, Lake
Geneva, Sturtevant, Union Grove, East Troy, Paddock Lake, Williams
Bay, Camp Lake, Wind Lake, Winthrop Harbor, Twin Lakes, Rochester,
Raymond, Wheatland, Yorkville, and Genoa City.

People attending The Wisconsin Womens Triathlon , and Bristol
Renaissance Faire  should seek safe shelter immediately!
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.
